purpose: Native-Ubuntu S1.2 backend validation gates after S1.1 host/simulator smoke passes

spikes.name: curobo_install_warmup
spikes.hypothesis: Pinned CuRobo v0.7.8 imports and returns typed IK/planning results on the target host
pass: pinned commit verified
import succeeds
at least one feasible collision-free fixed-pose result
no monotonic GPU-memory growth across warmup calls

spikes.name: renderer_camera_curobo_coexistence
spikes.hypothesis: Canonical low-memory RoboTwin rendering/cameras and CuRobo coexist within 6 GB VRAM
pass: no OOM or Vulkan device loss
GPU memory stabilizes after warmup
measured FPS and planning latency recorded

spikes.name: mplib_fallback
spikes.hypothesis: MPlib 0.2.1 can solve the same fixed SE3 request and return a collision-cleared joint path
pass: pinned/versioned package verified
IK and joint planning succeed on at least one feasible target
selected path passes current RoboTwin/SAPIEN collision recheck

spikes.name: timing_and_splice
spikes.hypothesis: Timed trajectories satisfy configured dynamic limits and replanning splice gates
pass: velocity and acceleration within configured limits
jerk metric recorded and within configured gate after allowed dilation
splice position/velocity discontinuity within configured gate

spikes.name: geometry_first_6dof_grasp
spikes.hypothesis: Geometry-first generator produces at least one feasible non-top-down full-6DoF grasp
pass: multiple candidate poses generated
candidate provenance complete
at least one candidate passes IK and collision checks

spikes.name: receding_horizon_recovery
spikes.hypothesis: A stale short segment is rejected and replaced after a deterministic scene perturbation
pass: scene revision change invalidates stale segment
new segment is collision-cleared before execution
detection and replan latency are recorded
no stale segment executes after invalidation
